description: Golden callable counts for the six supplied starter fixtures. Each is a source-level definition, not an invocation or declaration. Validate exact node spans during implementation.
notes: TypeScript's two function overload signatures are excluded; its single implementation is included.
Rust's required trait signature is excluded; its default method implementation is included.
Python's decorated function is counted once, with the decorator included in the definition range.
All nested and anonymous functions or closures are counted independently.
